title: San Diego Gaslamp Ghosts and True Crime Walking Tour
blurb:
Walk San Diego's famous Gaslamp Quarter and hear its real history learning about the crime, the scandal, and the ghost stories that outlived them on the highest rated tour in the city.

You'll walk the old Stingaree with a small group, through the blocks where gambling halls, brothels and bought-off cops ran the show. You'll hear about Room 309 at the Horton Grand, the visitors who contracted extinct diseases from the ghosts within the walls at the Davis-Horton House, the movement with the basement below the Balboa Theatre, and a block that used to be the city morgue.

This tour is for everyone and provides a true glimpse into what San Diego used to be like. We will eventually conclude your exciting night at the oldest and most haunted building downtown.
